flux_scale_explanation: Computed via: T_implied = (3/2) * P * (Phi_d * Iq_peak - Phi_q * Id_peak) at the (Id=0, Iq=I_rated_peak) sanity operating point, with Phi_d, Phi_q from FEM-verified AEDT solve. flux_scale = T_rated_RMexprt / T_implied. Multiply FEM flux linkages by this factor before plugging into T(Id, Iq) in mtpa_field_weakening.py.
